fields.name: game work memory
fields.meaning: Live game memory: the game runs out of the save chip, so everything below 5FD7 changes constantly while playing and is rebuilt at power-on; it is not the save
fields.evidence: decompiled save code never reads it as save data; boot with a save reads none of it before overwriting; every play session changes it

fields.name: work area below save
fields.meaning: Not save data: rewritten at every power-on even with blank memory and never read back first (most likely the top of the game stack)
fields.evidence: boot comparison (written at first boot with blank memory); boot reads (never read first)

fields.name: copy 1 start marker
fields.meaning: Start marker of the first save copy, always 02; a copy without it counts as empty
fields.evidence: decompiled writer stores it and validator rejects anything else; appears exactly when the game reports saving

fields.name: copy 1 length
fields.meaning: Length of the saved data block that follows, always 0B1F (2847 bytes)
fields.evidence: decompiled writer stores the pack length; natural save value 0b1f

fields.name: game tag
fields.meaning: Fixed tag text "ﾓﾝﾓﾝﾃﾞｼﾞﾓﾝ V002" plus a zero byte (half-width katakana and ASCII) copied from the game ROM; a copy whose tag does not match is not loaded
fields.evidence: decompiled save code copies 16 bytes from the ROM tag; loader compares all 16 before accepting a copy; byte match with the ROM verified

fields.name: resume mode
fields.meaning: Where Continue resumes: 0 = on the field map (normal save from the menu); 1 = inside a card-battle chapter (restarts from the chapter/stage numbers below); 2 = a second save path
fields.evidence: decompiled menu save sets 0, battle entry sets 1, a second routine sets 2; title Continue branches into three paths on this value; natural save value 0

fields.name: unknown 0a4c
fields.meaning: Unknown 4-byte value (zero in the natural save; cleared at new game)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack and new-game init; dump only

fields.name: battle counter
fields.meaning: Counter that grows by 1 or 3 after card battles and is capped at 10000 (12 in the natural save); a story event resets it to 0
fields.evidence: decompiled battle scoring (+1/+3, cap 10000) and story reset; live value rose 0 to 12 across played battles

fields.name: Digimon list
fields.meaning: 30 Digimon records of 72 bytes each (only the first is used in the natural save); per-record bytes below, shown for record 1
fields.evidence: decompiled pack copies 0x870 bytes; loader and species refresh step it in 0x48 strides

fields.name: record: in use
fields.meaning: 1 = this record holds a Digimon, 0 = empty
fields.evidence: decompiled species refresh tests ==1; natural save record 1 = 1, records 2-30 = 0

fields.name: record: species
fields.meaning: Species number of the Digimon (2 in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled species refresh uses it as the species-table index

fields.name: record: bytes 02-11
fields.meaning: 16-byte block copied from a table in the game ROM when a story event gives a Digimon (probably its base data and name); byte 02 is FF in empty records
fields.evidence: decompiled story event copies 0x10 bytes from a ROM table to record+2; new-game init sets byte 02 = FF

fields.name: record: bytes 12-23
fields.meaning: Unknown Digimon data (probably stats)
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: record: walk counters
fields.meaning: Two counters that rise together while walking on the map (1 to 5 between two saves made minutes apart)
fields.evidence: two saves from one play session differ only in these two bytes (per copy) plus checksums; live memory rose while walking

fields.name: record: bytes 26-47
fields.meaning: Unknown Digimon data; bytes 26, 2F and 30 are cleared at new game and byte 2F when a Digimon is given
fields.evidence: decompiled new-game init and give-Digimon code; dump

fields.name: unknown list 2a68
fields.meaning: Unknown 32-byte list (02 then FF fill in the natural save; all FF at new game)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack and new-game fill

fields.name: unknown count 2a90
fields.meaning: Unknown count-like byte (1 in the natural save; 0 at new game), probably the number of used entries of the previous list
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack and new-game clear

fields.name: Digimon count
fields.meaning: Number of used records in the Digimon list (1)
fields.evidence: decompiled species refresh loops over it; give-Digimon and gift code append at this index and add 1

fields.name: unknown 0a30
fields.meaning: Unknown 3 bytes (FF FF FF, the new-game value)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack; new-game init sets FF

fields.name: unknown 0a34
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack only

fields.name: unknown 0a2e
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack only

fields.name: event triggers
fields.meaning: 18 event trigger flags; a value of 1 starts the matching story event once (the first is 1, set at new game)
fields.evidence: decompiled story events test trigger==1 with its done flag; new-game init sets the first to 1

fields.name: Digimon capacity
fields.meaning: How many Digimon the player may hold; 8 at new game, story events raise it by 2, 3 or 5
fields.evidence: decompiled new-game init sets 8; story/quest code adds; gift code refuses when full

fields.name: species table
fields.meaning: One byte per species (113): 2 = owned/registered. In this edition a new game already marks every species 2 (all 113 are 2 in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled new-game init sets all to 2; species refresh sets 2 for each Digimon held

fields.name: unknown table 13b2
fields.meaning: Unknown 73-byte table; a new game sets every entry to 2 in this edition (all 2 in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled new-game init sets 2; one routine sets entries to 2

fields.name: per-species counters
fields.meaning: One counter per species (113), raised by 1 after battles and capped at 100 (all zero in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled counter code (+1, cap 100); new-game init clears

fields.name: unknown records 0950
fields.meaning: Unknown 216 bytes = 3 records of 72 bytes, same size as a Digimon record (all zero). Saved but never restored when loading.
fields.evidence: decompiled save packs it but the loader skips it on unpack; new-game init clears byte 0 of each record

fields.name: unknown 0a36
fields.meaning: Unknown 11 bytes (zero)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack; new-game init clears

fields.name: map number
fields.meaning: Map the player is on (4 = the island area in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled story events set map values; live value 4 on the island in every played session there

fields.name: player X
fields.meaning: Player X position on the map (0x58 next to the terminal box)
fields.evidence: live value moved 0x58 to 0x38 after 4 steps left and back on return; new game sets 0x78

fields.name: player Y
fields.meaning: Player Y position on the map (0x48)
fields.evidence: live value moved 0x50 to 0x48 when the player walked up to the box; new game sets 0x58

fields.name: order table 2864
fields.meaning: 18 bytes 00..11 (set in this order at new game); used as an index table by the field code
fields.evidence: decompiled new-game init sets 0..17; field code reads it

fields.name: unknown flag 2858
fields.meaning: Unknown flag (0); a story event sets it to 1
fields.evidence: decompiled story event sets 1; new-game init clears

fields.name: event done flags
fields.meaning: 12 flags set to 1 when a story event has been played (all 0 in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled story events set them after playing; new-game init clears

fields.name: unknown flag 2958
fields.meaning: Unknown flag (0); set to 1 by one routine
fields.evidence: decompiled set/clear; dump

fields.name: unknown 437c
fields.meaning: Unknown 20 bytes (E8 E8 EA EA EA, then FF and 00 in the natural save); one routine scans it for FF
fields.evidence: decompiled scan; dump

fields.name: unknown 2a10
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack; new-game init clears

fields.name: story progress byte 29f4
fields.meaning: Unknown byte, 0x1E at new game; story events set it to 0x1F and 0x20
fields.evidence: decompiled new-game init and two story-event stores

fields.name: chapter number
fields.meaning: Card-battle chapter number (0 in the natural save; menu choices set 1-17); Continue in resume mode 1 uses it with the next byte to pick the chapter
fields.evidence: decompiled menu sets 1..0x11; Continue compares chapter/stage pairs; cleared at battle setup

fields.name: stage number
fields.meaning: Stage within the chapter (0); checked together with the chapter number; a battle-time save stores it plus one
fields.evidence: decompiled battle-time save adds 1 before saving and subtracts after; Continue compares it

fields.name: unknown 0946-094b
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack only

fields.name: unknown 133a-133f
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack only

fields.name: unknown 42f2
fields.meaning: Unknown 3 bytes (FF FF FF, the new-game value)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack; new-game init sets FF

fields.name: unknown 287e
fields.meaning: Unknown 32-bit value (zero; cleared at new game)
fields.evidence: decompiled pack/unpack and new-game clear

fields.name: copy 1 end marker
fields.meaning: End marker, always 03
fields.evidence: decompiled writer stores it and validator rejects anything else

fields.name: copy 1 checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT (reflected poly 0x1021, start 0) over the length field, data and end marker, stored low byte first
fields.evidence: recomputed independently on 4 saves x both copies: all match; decompiled checksum routine with ROM tables

fields.name: copy 1 padding
fields.meaning: Unused gap between the copies (zero)
fields.evidence: copies are 0xB29 apart, a framed copy is 0xB25 long

fields.name: copy 2 (backup)
fields.meaning: Second identical copy with the same layout as 6000-6B28; written right after the first on every save; read only when the first copy is missing, damaged or has the wrong tag
fields.evidence: decompiled save writes both slots; loader falls back to copy 2; both copies identical in every save; boot with a good copy 1 never touches copy 2

fields.name: gap after save
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: gift buffer
fields.meaning: 16 bytes checked after loading: when they equal the game tag and there is room, the 72-byte Digimon record that follows at 7810 is added to the party, the game saves itself, and this tag is cleared (most likely a link/download gift)
fields.evidence: decompiled loader compares with the ROM tag, appends the record, re-saves, clears; boot reads it first

fields.name: gift record
fields.meaning: The Digimon record that goes with the gift buffer (zero in the natural save)
fields.evidence: decompiled loader copies 0x48 bytes from 7810 into the party

fields.name: unused tail
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: zero in every save
